_comment: Reference app settings for any implementation. Copy the Values into your local.settings.json (set FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME to 'node', 'dotnet-isolated', or 'python') or into the Function App's environment variables. Keys are the same across languages — see CONTRACT.md §4. Provider API keys are NOT here; they live in Key Vault. EPP_DECRYPTION_KEY_PEM is a Key Vault reference in Azure.

Values.EPP_DECRYPTION_KEY_PEM: <RSA private key: PEM, or base64 over the PEM as the setup script writes it; in Azure a Key Vault reference>
Values._comment_auth: Enable Easy Auth on the Function App (unauthenticatedClientAction=Return401, allowedApplications pinned to EPP_EXPECTED_CLIENT_ID) AND set EPP_REQUIRE_AUTH=true in any real deployment. false is for local func start only.
Values._comment_provider_timeout: Outbound provider timeout in milliseconds (default 1500, cap 2500). Not an end-to-end deadline; Key Vault/OAuth are outside it and Python uses connect/read inactivity timeouts. See CONTRACT.md.
Values._comment_provider_oauth: Set EPP_PROVIDER_AUTH_MODE=oauth2 to send the provider an app-only Entra JWT we mint (client-credentials) instead of an API key. Issuer is our app (EPP_PROVIDER_CLIENT_ID), authority is the provider's tenant (EPP_PROVIDER_TENANT_ID), audience is the provider's app via EPP_PROVIDER_SCOPE. Set EPP_PROVIDER_MI_CLIENT_ID for secretless workload-identity federation (a user-assigned managed identity federated on our app), OR provide the client secret as a Key Vault secret name (EPP_PROVIDER_CLIENT_SECRET_NAME).
Values.EPP_PROVIDER_MI_CLIENT_ID: <user-assigned managed identity client id (federated on our app)>
Values.EPP_PROVIDER_CLIENT_SECRET_NAME: <Key Vault secret name holding our client secret (only if not using a managed identity)>
Values._comment_log_plaintext: DIAGNOSTICS ONLY. true writes the phone number and passcode to the log. Never enable in production.
